title: Brooklyn Bridge, looking from Brooklyn toward old New York, U.S.A (NYPL b11708026-G91F173 154F)
blurb: * Includes views by B. W. Kilburn, Keystone View Co., Underwood & Underwood and other photographers and publishers. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Title devised by cataloger. View of the Brooklyn Bridge: construction views including view of the N.Y. Caisson "with iron lining and shafts in place," and other views of towers, cables, etc.; general views form the harbor and shores, views of promenade, including police patrolling, railroad lines and street cars, roadways; views of area around approaches, shipping, ferries.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.07% vertical error and 0.0° of rotation. Depth measured gentle (0.39% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
